title: Deep Space 2 Mars microprobe and its aeroshell
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: One Deep Space 2 microprobe at true size. Left: the whole aeroshell (350 mm across, 275 mm high), a blunt 45-degree heat shield with a rounded white back shell, nose down as it fell. Right: a probe out of its shell, laid out as it was meant to end up: the aftbody (136 mm across, 105 mm high) with its 127 mm whip antenna, sun sensor and pressure sensor on top, and the bullet-shaped forebody (106 mm long, 39 mm across) with its side drill port hanging below on the flat flex cable. The cable is drawn 0.3 m long (it could pay out to about a metre in the ground). Simplified: outside shapes only, small fittings placed by eye.
